area_desc: Baltimore County, MD; Howard County, MD; Carroll County, MD
headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 27 at 3:42PM EDT until July 28 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
description: At 342 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
instruction: Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles. Move to higher ground now.
